findings.summary: The product lineage launched publicly as Hectic FreelancerOS on June 21, 2022, before the later Moxie name.
The strongest recurring value is replacing separate CRM, proposal, contract, invoicing, scheduling, time-tracking, portal, and light project tools.
Freelancers repeatedly describe the core client-to-invoice workflow as intuitive and time-saving.
Support and frequent product improvements receive repeated praise.
Project management is lighter and sometimes clunkier than dedicated tools, especially for complex team planning and automation.
Navigation, mobile polish, advanced CRM functions, packages, and automation coverage appear as narrower gaps.
Trustpilot and AppSumo scores are very high, but both samples have selection effects: Moxie solicits Trustpilot reviews and AppSumo reviewers are lifetime-deal buyers.
Digital Macaroni did not perform a new hands-on test. One external source reports six months of use and discloses affiliate links.

product.name: Moxie
product.short_description: Small-business operations suite built for freelancers rather than enterprises.

sources.excerpt: Today, Hectic announced the launch of FreelancerOS.
sources.summary: First-party launch record establishes exact public availability under the former Hectic name. The record must be treated as product lineage, not as proof that the Moxie brand existed that day.
sources.title: Hectic announces all-in-one tool for freelancers

sources.excerpt: Reviewers often praise the all-in-one workflow, support, setup, and value.
sources.summary: Trustpilot showed 536 reviews. The profile is claimed, paid, and says Moxie asks customers for reviews, so the high score is useful but must be disclosed as a solicited sample.
sources.title: Moxie Reviews

sources.excerpt: Verified buyers praise value, client portals, invoicing, automation, and consolidation.
sources.summary: AppSumo showed 83 reviews from lifetime-deal buyers. Praise is strong, but this cohort paid under special deal terms and should not be treated as representative of monthly subscribers.
sources.title: Moxie Reviews

sources.excerpt: Users value time savings and breadth, while citing navigation, project management, support, and missing workflow options.
sources.summary: G2 had only four reviews, so it supplies concrete details but not strong prevalence evidence.
sources.title: Moxie Reviews and Product Details

sources.excerpt: Moxie covers clients, projects, proposals, contracts, invoices, time, schedules, and accounting workflows.
sources.summary: Capterra confirms the product scope and contains limited verified customer feedback. It is a supporting source rather than a high-volume signal.
sources.title: Moxie Software Review 2026

sources.excerpt: Mobile reviewers praise an integrated freelancer workflow and intuitive project-to-invoice flow.
sources.summary: The App Store showed 20 ratings. Reviews provide mobile-specific evidence and reinforce the all-in-one workflow theme.
sources.title: Moxie Built for freelancers Ratings and Reviews

sources.excerpt: The reviewer reports six months of real client use and calls Moxie a strong all-in-one CRM for solo freelancers.
sources.summary: A disclosed hands-on review supports the workflow and value findings. It includes affiliate links, so its commercial incentive must remain attached to the evidence.
sources.title: Moxie Review 2026: Six Months of Real Use
